historical_record.description: The International Hotel was built in 1907 and became a fixture of Manilatown, popular with Asian immigrants and particularly with Filipino bachelors. Its tenants were evicted after a decade-long campaign and a police standoff in August 1978, and the building was demolished in 1981. The site stayed empty until 2004, when a new I-Hotel of 105 senior apartments opened, with a community centre and a historical display on the ground floor. The Kearny Street Workshop was founded in the old hotel's basement in 1972 and opened a gallery on the Jackson Street side in 1974.
